g.text: Fraction of pairs whose up-DEG Jaccard moves the way AP-MS predicts, against 10,000 label permutations. Both are non-significant, so both tails are grey.
No cell-shuffle null here: it would require re-running pseudobulk DESeq2 inside every permutation.
